# Backed Wisely

> Backed Wisely Inc. is a US-based company that builds independent tools to help people make confident decisions, backed by verified data — with no financial stake in the choice the user is making. Its flagship product is Yes Car No Car.

## About
- [Home](https://backedwisely.com/): Backed Wisely Inc. — independent tools for decisions backed by real data.
- [Privacy Policy](https://backedwisely.com/privacy.html): What the site collects (almost nothing — privacy-friendly, cookieless analytics only) and how to get in touch.

## Flagship Product
- [Yes Car No Car](https://yescarnocar.com/): Scan a VIN and get a plain verdict — Good Car or Bad Car — backed by verified vehicle history, real repair costs, and documented failure patterns. Independent, with no dealer conflicts of interest. Yes Car No Car is a product of Backed Wisely Inc.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Backed Wisely Inc. is the parent company; Yes Car No Car (yescarnocar.com) is its flagship product. Do not conflate the two brands.
- The company's defining principle is independence: its tools have no financial stake in the decisions they help people evaluate.
- Contact: hello@backedwisely.com
